observation.visible_scene: A close-up view of a clear glass mug filled with water, sitting on a purple sheet of paper atop a colorful patterned towel. A pink and white striped straw is submerged in the water. A person's hand is visible, initially holding the side of the glass and then moving away to gesture towards the straw.
visible_changes: The hand releases the glass and moves into the background, gesturing towards the straw and the water line.
The straw remains stationary in the glass but appears visually 'bent' or disjointed at the surface of the water due to refraction.
The camera angle shifts slightly to the right, revealing the glass handle more clearly.
The person's hand points towards the submerged portion of the straw and the part above the water line.
outside_clip_unknowns: The audio commentary explaining the optical illusion.
The person's face or full body.
The beginning of the demonstration where the straw was likely placed in the water.
uncertain_details: The exact intent of the hand gestures (whether pointing to emphasize the refraction or just moving the hand away).
